additions.name: China Mobile Beijing International Information Port No6 / C18 Data Center Development

status.summary: Official supervision procurement candidate notice dated September 1 confirms the No6/C18 development. Two planned data-center buildings plus associated power buildings are one project at the existing campus. Procurement and scheduled service dates do not establish physical works or a government construction permission.

locator.precision: Representative marker inside the existing mapped Phase3 sector of China Mobile International Information Port. Locates the wider named campus only; it does not locate No6/C18, a new data-center building, a parcel boundary, or the full-campus centroid.
locator.identity_review: Official No6/C18 notices identify China Mobile International Information Port in Changping at the North Sixth Ring / Badaling Expressway junction. OSM way768393624 is explicitly named China Mobile International Information Port Phase3; the operator contact page corroborates Phase3 at Manbai Road, Shahe, Changping. Point is the arithmetic bounding-box center of that polygon and is verified inside it. The May26 official design notice says southeast C18 whereas July9/September1 official notices say northeast; neither direction is resolved by this marker. OSM Phase6 is not asserted to be No6 parcel.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Community mapping gives no measured positional accuracy. Offset from the existing Phase3 marker to No6/C18 is unknown; numeric precision is arithmetic/source precision, not survey accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Reviewed 419 projects, 395 sites and all 231 original imported records. No Beijing/Changping/International Information Port project or source alias occurs. Existing CN records are Haidong Phase2, Shaotang Shaoguan and Guizhou B5/B6. Nearest existing site is LG Uplus Paju AIDC, 945.43km away. No6/C18 is one development within one campus; phases mapped in OSM are not extra projects or sites.
additions.successor_review: Reviewed official September1 procurement notice and project registration on October13. A later September9 supervision award is indexed in secondary mirrors but its primary page was not recovered; it would remain procurement evidence. No verified later physical start, completion, operation, cancellation or granted development/building permit found. OSM commercial/construction tags and version dates are not lifecycle evidence.
